about_the_game:
🩸 A choice must be made

Five friends. One sealed chamber. Outside, the world collapses.
A forgotten ritual demands a human sacrifice. Will trust survive — or shatter completely?

Orikai: The Sacrifice is a psychological horror about moral dilemmas, emotional pressure, and impossible decisions. After triggering an ancient elemental ritual, five teenagers must confront both the end of the world and each other. As disasters rage above, tensions underground rise — until someone must go.

There’s only one way out. But who will take it?

🎭 Meet the Characters

🎮 Miles – The Player Character
Your perspective. Torn between responsibility and fear, Miles must protect his sister while facing impossible choices.

💖 Emma – The Girlfriend
Honest and caring, but jealousy makes Naomi’s presence hard to ignore. She wants to trust Miles, yet doubts creep in.

🧸 Ruby – The Little Sister (15)
Sweet and curious, clutching her stuffed toy for comfort. Too young to be here, but her presence changes everything.

👊 Tobin – The Best Friend
Miles’ childhood companion. Loyal and humorous on the surface, but deeply afraid of losing those he loves.

👠 Naomi – The Ex-Girlfriend
Now with Tobin. Bold and sharp-tongued, she forces others to face truths they’d rather avoid — especially Miles.

✨ Features

🧠 Narrative-driven horror with deep psychological themes
🔄 Multiple endings with high replayability
🗣️ Dynamic conversations that shape relationships and trust
🥤 Inventory-based puzzles using symbolic and practical items
🔥 Elemental rituals: fire, water, wind, earth... and something darker
🖼️ Hand-drawn visuals in a dark, stylized comic aesthetic
🎮 Full controller support
💀 No combat. No easy choices. Just consequences

🆕 A free demo will be available soon – try the beginning of the story before release!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes of psychological horror, frequent depictions of death and violence — including murder among friends, blood, disturbing situations, and morally challenging decisions. The game also explores sexual relationships between characters.
